mission: Expand Fix-R deferred IPs (Foundry Milvus + Observability ClickHouse) to >=150 SUBSTANTIVE lines each
scope_note: User mission framing referenced 'Foundry IP-086..097 (12 IPs)' and 'Observability IP-026..031 (5 IPs)'. Ground truth in branch oya-microservice-flat-layout-buildout-2026-05-17 is: (a) Foundry IP-086..090 are providers µservice adapter/router IPs (not Milvus); the Milvus deferral set authored by Fix-R is IP-091..097 (7 IPs). (b) Observability IP-026..031 are realtime transport + tail-sampling IPs (not ClickHouse); the ClickHouse deferral set authored by Fix-R is IP-021..025 (5 IPs). Total: 12 IPs matching the mission headline count. Proceeded with the concrete ground-truth set.

foundry_phase_addendum.reason: Existing PHASE-01-FOUNDRY-FOUNDATION.md predates ADR-0192 (promoted 2026-05-18); new PHASE-02 entry needed to anchor IP-091..097 inside M01 sequencing.

observability_phase_addendum.reason: Existing PHASE-01-AGENTIC-SLO-GATED-PROMOTION.md predates ADR-0193 (promoted 2026-05-18); new PHASE-02 entry needed to anchor IP-021..025.

authority_adrs_referenced: ADR-0193 OLAP analytics warehouse canonical ClickHouse

buildability_self_audit.method: Sampled 3 IPs at random (IP-091 IaC bootstrap, IP-094 adapter crate, IP-023 ops portal MVs) and traced whether a stranger could ship each IP using only the document.

samples.rationale: Document lists every file target with line range, the cluster topology table, acceptance criteria, smoke-test cases with names + locations, audit-chain seal contract, rollback ladder (5 steps), blocking deps (4 items), exit criteria (7 items). A stranger can: read the topology table -> identify 6 coord + 12 worker + storage planes; open the Helm chart at microservices/intelligence/iac/helm/milvus/; run helm install per dev cell instructions; verify the 12 smoke test rows; emit the audit-chain bootstrap event. Capacity sizing baseline + security posture sections make pod-resource calculations concrete.

Document lists 16 file targets with line ranges, vendors the .proto, pins all 6 workload-class params, gives the full VectorStore trait surface, names 13 integration tests, sets the layer placement per ADR-0083, prescribes the connection-pool size table, and ties exit criteria to MS-MARCO recall + p99 latency benchmarks. A stranger can: scaffold the crate from the file-target table, generate gRPC from the vendored proto, implement each trait method against the named module, run the 13 named tests, hit the recall + latency targets.

Document lists 16 file targets, defines all 4 MVs with full SQL bodies (or canonical equivalent), specifies target-table -> public-view consumption contract, sets row-level policy for the per-tenant cost MV, defines the cost-unit-rate dictionary refresh cadence, names 12 correctness tests, ties exit criteria to drift < 1% vs Mimir. A stranger can: apply the DDL via the IP-022 bootstrap Job, validate each MV via the named correctness tests, wire the public views into the ops portal.

buildability_self_audit.result: All 3 sampled IPs are buildable by a stranger with no external context beyond the cited ADRs + the cross-IP dependencies declared in 'Blocking deps'.

cargo_build_workspace.note: Background run completed exit 0. (rtk-tee log captured 6 pre-existing connector-adapter missing-lib errors for oya-connector-{epic-fhir,gusto,netsuite,quickbooks,rippling,salesforce}-adapter; these are unrelated to this IP work — all 12 changes are markdown-only — and predate this branch's IP-091..097 / IP-021..025 expansion.)

markdown_only_changes.rationale: Every IP expansion + 2 phase addenda are .md authored documents; no Rust code was modified. Workspace build state is therefore unchanged from the branch's pre-existing state.

result: All 12 Fix-R-deferred IPs (Foundry Milvus IP-091..097; Observability ClickHouse IP-021..025) expanded to >=150 substantive lines each (range 150-180). Two PHASE-02 addenda anchor the IPs in M01 sequencing. Three-IP buildability self-audit passes.
